sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/365 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 365, grids 518-520 and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sampled units on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12; grids for 2027-01-12; read 2026-10-30)

values.note: $27 a night for a non-electric site (RV sites, pads 35-45 ft); electric $37; full hookups $50; the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) non-electric $23, electric and full-hookup $33 (full-service sites have no water then). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Mosquito Lake campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 27.00 with IsRVSite true, Electric 37.00, Full Hookup 50.00); units 107, 001 and 009 on Sat 2027-06-19 (27.00 / 37.00 / 50.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (23.00 / 33.00 / 33.00), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mosquito-lake-state-park-campground ('40 Full-service sites', '178 Electric sites (20/30/50 amp service)') + ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50'; full-hookup sites list water and sewer hookups), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 220 web-bookable RV sites, all back-in: 164 electric, 40 full hookup and 16 non-electric, pads 30-45 ft. ODNR counts 40 full-service, 178 electric and 16 non-electric. Two yurts; two tent-only group camps. Pets allowed on all sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 519-520 + search/details (IsRVSite true on all 220 campsites, Pad Length 30-45, PullInTypeName 'Back In') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mosquito-lake-state-park-campground ('pets on all sites', group camps 'Tent camping only, no RVs allowed'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Two showerhouses with flush toilets and laundry; seasonal camp store (330-638-5700) with ice, firewood and supplies; boat launch for campers with shoreline tie-ups. Off-peak (November 1 to April 1) the showerhouses close and pit latrines stay open; water at the dump station.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mosquito-lake-state-park-campground ('Two showerhouses with flush toilets, laundry facilities, and pit latrines', 'A seasonal camp store', 'Boat launching area for campers with shoreline tie-ups', 'Off-peak Season ... Showerhouses are closed for winter season'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to April 1: full-service sites have no water at the site and the showerhouses close. ReserveOhio sells 99 electric and full-hookup sites for a January night.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/mosquito-lake-state-park-campground ('Off-peak Season: From November 1 to April 1 ...') + ReserveOhio grids 519/520 for 2027-01-12 (72 + 27 units free), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance, online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

note: Sites 218-220, on the cul-de-sac at the end of the 210s loop beside the two yurts, sit at the edge of a weedy cove of Mosquito Creek Lake; sites 66-69 look toward the lake through trees. --Claude
summary: Fees $27 base (+$10 electric, +$23 full hookup) confirmed. Added hookups 50/W/S, 220 back-in RV sites to 45 ft, showers/flush/laundry/store, year-round season, ReserveOhio booking (180 days, max 14). Note: rewritten from the site plots ('cul-de-sac 214-224, 222' - 222 is not a campsite; the waterside ones are 218-220).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (330) 637-2856; camp store 330-638-5700.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront, evidence 'camp loops set back 80-150m from shore'): plotted at z18, electric sites 218, 219 and 220 (and the yurts 216-217) sit at the shoreline of a cove filled with aquatic weed, with open water beyond about 50-100 m; sites 66-69 are 40-60 m from the cove behind trees. ODNR: 'Some of the sites have a lakeshore views'. A few-site claim at most.
Construction notice on the ODNR campground page: 'Starting Oct 3rd road construction will begin at the park's marina and beach parking lots until further notice.' Not in the campground.
